card.name: Hydration and fluid-related word starts
card.fires_on: Marks the point just before a fluid-related word is completed, such as the re in rehydration, the S in Sulfate, or the di in dihydrate. It also fires on words like well or of that lead into hydrated or water.

modes.label: Re/di before hydration
modes.description: A word start that is followed by hydration or hydrate.
modes.example: despite adequate<< re>>hydration, CrCl should be determined before

modes.label: Sulfate in salt names
modes.description: The S that begins Sulfate in the bowel-prep solution name.
modes.example: Sodium Sulfate, Potassium<< S>>ulfate and Magnesium Sulfate

modes.label: Words before water or hydrated
modes.description: A linking word just before water or hydrated.
modes.example: ensure that the patient is<< well>> hydrated before the procedure

card.writes: It suppresses liquid-related words, so it keeps the model from predicting 'liquid' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on a word start just before hydration, sulfate or water-type words, and it pushes the model away from saying 'liquid'.
